edits.value_json: {"text":"Shuowen interprets 包 as a pregnant figure with 巳 inside, understood as an unformed child. 字源 gives a separate received-form analysis: 勹 wraps 巳, read as an unborn child, and together they convey 胞衣. 字源 labels a glyph sequence 《说文》小篆, 秦, 睡甲, 汉, 《篆隶表》, and 楷书; these labels do not authenticate the displayed forms as dated artifacts.","evidence_ids":["ref003","ref061","ref070","ref071"]}
